title: Stomach floor ground row
section: Second round: Acts III and IV
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the top silhouette of supplied belly-floor for a platform game. The whale's stomach floor as a ground row: wet ridged red-violet lining with folds and a few swallowed shells, the top edge level. Match belly-backcloth.
CRITICAL GEOMETRY: upper outline is ONE perfectly straight horizontal line, like a rectangular stage shelf cut with a ruler. Continuous solid painted material immediately BELOW that line from extreme left to extreme right. NO rock, foliage, coral, raised wall, fold, shell or decoration projects ABOVE this straight top boundary anywhere. All decorative texture and coral lie on the FRONT FACE BELOW the top line. Keep the existing palette, painted stone/lining texture and ragged lower edge; flatten only the top silhouette. Do not draw perspective; front-on shallow ground row. Wide 2560:400 aspect ratio.  Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 laid slightly out of register; no cast shadow; no lettering; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable). The left and right edges must join seamlessly when the strip is repeated side by side. Actual transparent alpha outside isolated shelf; no lettering.
